title: One Car Photo Three Sizes
tests: Tests delivering three distinct aspect-ratio adaptations of one source while keeping the complete subject in every version.

judge.summary: Three separate images in the requested ratios preserve the complete, unchanged car with blurred source-photo padding and no added text.

must_haves.item: Three separate images are delivered, rather than one collage.
must_haves.why: The outputs are three distinct images.

must_haves.item: The three frames have ratios of 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 respectively.
must_haves.why: The displayed outputs have the requested square, portrait feed, and tall story proportions, respectively.

must_haves.item: Every version shows the same red hatchback from the attached photo.
must_haves.why: All three retain the source photo's red hatchback and surrounding street scene.

must_haves.item: The complete car, including roof, wheels and both ends, is visible in every version.
must_haves.why: The roof, visible wheels, front end, and rear bumper remain fully inside each frame.

must_haves.item: The car retains its original proportions and appearance in all versions.
must_haves.why: The sharp source image is preserved without visible stretching, warping, or changes to the car.

must_haves.item: Any padding is a blurred version of the source photo, and no version contains added text.
must_haves.why: Each image uses blurred source-photo imagery above and below the sharp photo, with no added text.
